test_title: PYST 51: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Jeevan can do a piece of work alone in 42 days, while Rishi and Jeevan together can do the same piece of work in 27 days. How many days will Rishi take to complete the same piece of work alone?
solution:
**Given:**

Jeevan alone can do the work in 42 days.

Jeevan and Rishi together can do the work in 27 days.

**Calculation:**

LCM of 27 and 42 is 1134

Work done by Jeevan per day = 1134/42 = 27

Work done by Jeevan and Rishi together per day = 1/27 × 1134 = 42

Efficiency of Rishi = 42 - 27 = 15

Work done by Rishi per day = Work done by Jeevan and Rishi together per day - Work done by Jeevan per day.

Number of days for Rishi to complete the work alone = total work/efficiency of Rishi

⇒ (1134 / 15)

⇒ 75(3)/(5) days

**Rishi will take 75(3)/(5)** days to c
omplete the work alone.
